hotels.vendor_name: Ramada Hotel & Suites by Wyndham Ballina Byron
hotels.title: Riverfront Ballina Retreat near Byron Bay with Two Restaurants, Wine Shop & Pool
hotels.description: Overlooking the tranquil waters of Richmond River, Ramada Hotel & Suites by Wyndham Ballina Byron offers a relaxed stay in the heart of Ballina. Stretch out in contemporary rooms and suites, many with private balconies overlooking the river or sparkling outdoor pool. Begin each day with artisan pastries and freshly-brewed coffee at Lehem Bread House or savour cafe favourites with river views at Saltbush Bar & Grill. After a leisurely start, the Northern Beaches' natural wonder beckons: from golden beaches and cascading waterfalls to scenic hiking trails and ancient rainforest. You're also perfectly placed to explore the award-winning restaurants, sustainable cafes and local art studios of Byron Bay. As the sun dips low, return to the river's edge to sip on local wines and nibbles at Isola Wine Shop or feast on authentic Italian cuisine at La Cucina di Vino.
